title: Dispatch CTW 3: Names of Dead Operators Found in the Chorus
summary: The voices match recordings from a station lost in 1891.
topic: The Choir in the Telegraph Wires
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: A cylinder held in the Post Office archive contains a training demonstration made by operators at Hollow Junction before a fire closed the station. Two voices on it resemble the choir’s leading singers. The likeness was recognized independently by retired staff who worked there.

The station’s telegraph circuit was cut after the fire. Its copper remained in the ground. Surveyors found that a new Alderwick trunk line crosses it beneath an old bridge. Mr. Bell has ordered the junction isolated.
